_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-68. The org `no-todo` agent is seeded advisory (scripts/seed-org-agent.sh, PREREQ_CHECK-gated), and advisory is precisely the mode where a critical-severity org finding must NOT block: the check still passes and no blocking title appears. That is a deterministic enforcement rule, not model judgement. The admin/member 403 API surface, the blocking-mode walk, the name-clash precedence and the Postgres parity all need the manual toggle in Settings and stay manual.
